messages.content: "請你先計算從一副有52張牌的牌組中抽出一張紅心的機率，其中有13張紅心，然後再計算從同一副牌組中抽出一張皇后的機率，其中有4個皇后。之後，能否找出藝術家'巴勃羅·畢卡索'最近的作品，並提供詳細描述？最後，能否找出在紐約12月舉行且評分高的最受歡迎的雕塑展覽？"

function.name: get_sculpture_info
function.description: Retrieves the most recent artwork by a specified artist with its detailed description. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of the sculpture. This is optional. Default is the current year.

detail.description: If True, it provides detailed description of the sculpture. Defaults to False.

function.name: find_exhibition
function.description: Locate the most popular exhibitions based on criteria like location, time, art form, and user ratings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the exhibition is held, e.g., New York, NY.

art_form.description: The form of art the exhibition is displaying e.g., sculpture.

month.description: The month of exhibition. Default value will return upcoming events.

user_ratings.description: Select exhibitions with user rating threshold. Default is 'average'.

function.name: card_game_probability_calculate
function.description: Calculate the probability of drawing a certain card or suit from a deck of cards. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

total_cards.description: Total number of cards in the deck.

desired_cards.description: Number of cards in the deck that satisfy the conditions.

cards_drawn.description: Number of cards drawn from the deck.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1. Probability calculation: from a 52-card deck, probability of drawing a heart (13 hearts). Then probability of drawing a queen (4 queens). They want calculations.

2. Find the most recent work by artist '巴勃羅·畢卡索' (Pablo Picasso) and provide detailed description. Use function get_sculpture_info? Actually they ask for "最近的作品" which could be sculpture? But Picasso was painter; but we can still use get_sculpture_info? The function expects artist_name, year optional, detail optional. We can call get_sculpture_info with artist_name='巴勃羅·畢卡索', detail=True. It returns info about most recent sculpture? Might not exist. But we can still call.

3. Find most popular exhibitions in New York December high-rated sculptures. Use find_exhibition with location="New York", art_form="sculpture", month="December", user_ratings="high".

We need to call functions accordingly.

First two probabilities: we can compute manually: P(heart)=13/52=0.25. P(queen)=4/52≈0.0769.

We can also use card_game_probability_calculate function for each? The function calculates probability given total_cards, desired_cards, cards_drawn. For one draw, cards_drawn defaults to 1. So we can call twice.

Thus we should call card_game_probability_calculate twice: first with total_cards=52, desired_cards=13. second with total_cards=52, desired_cards=4.

Then call get_sculpture_info with artist_name='巴勃羅·畢卡索', detail=True.

Then call find_exhibition with location="New York", art_form="sculpture", month="December", user_ratings="high".

We need to output results after calling functions. We'll do calls sequentially.

We'll produce JSON calls.
